title: Small data-plane API change needs review

question: I have a spec PR with a small additive change to my data-plane API. How do I request Board review and get signoff without booking a meeting?
ground_truth: For a minor change that qualifies for offline review, email azureapirbcore@microsoft.com at least two days before you need signoff. Include your spec PR, design documents and hero scenarios, the prior review, and a summary of your changes. Not every additive change qualifies; the Board can arrange a synchronous session for larger changes. data-plane-review-requested queues the review, while the protected data-plane-review-signoff label records authorized signoff. I cannot grant that signoff or apply labels for you. You can discuss the request here; there is no need to repost it in this same General channel.
